=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "IRQ-PARAM", "section": "1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."},
    {"id": "IRQ-RESET", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-REG-RW", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."},
    {"id": "IRQ-READ", "section": "4.1", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LEVEL", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."},
    {"id": "IRQ-EDGE", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."},
    {"id": "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "section": "4.2", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-W1C", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-ACK", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."},
    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "section": "4.3", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},
    {"id": "IRQ-MASK", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."},
    {"id": "IRQ-PRIORITY", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."},
    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "section": "4.4", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_smoke", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Reset, enable source 1 in level mode, and pulse src[1]. Check that irq rises, that a CLAIM read returns bit 31 set with id 1, and that after a W1C write and src low irq falls."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM-SWEEP", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_param_unused_bits", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Run with N=2, 8 and 32. Write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, then read back. Check that bits N and up read zero and that bits below N behave as specified at every N."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_reset_values", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "Set ENABLE, MODE and PENDING nonzero and hold an edge-mode src high, then assert rst_n low for one edge. Check that all three registers read zero. After reset, with the edge source still high and MODE re-set to edge, check that PENDING sets, which shows the remembered level cleared."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_enable_mode_rw", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Write random wdata to ENABLE and MODE. Check that each reads back wdata[N-1:0] and that the other register is unchanged."},
    {"id": "T-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_read_no_side_effect", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "With known register state, sweep addr 0..3 with we low over many cycles, including CLAIM. Check that rdata changes in the same cycle as addr and that no register value changes."},
    {"id": "T-LEVEL", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_level_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL"], "rationale": "With a level-mode source held high, clear PENDING by W1C each cycle. Check that the bit is set again at every rising edge while src is high and stays clear once src is low."},
    {"id": "T-EDGE", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_edge_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "With an edge-mode source, drive low then high and hold, clearing PENDING after the first set. Check that the bit sets once and does not re-set while held high, and that it sets again after a low-high transition."},
    {"id": "T-DETECT-DIS", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_detect_while_disabled", "proves": ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "With ENABLE=0, drive sources in both modes. Check that the PENDING bits set and irq stays low. Then enable the sources and check that irq rises with no new stimulus."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_pending_w1c", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "rationale": "With several PENDING bits set (sources quiet), write random masks to PENDING. Check that bits written 1 clear, bits written 0 keep their value, and no clear bit is set by a write."},
    {"id": "T-ACK", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_claim_ack", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "With several PENDING bits set, write each id to CLAIM, plus ids N..31 and upper wdata bits set. Check that only the named bit clears and that ids of N or more change nothing."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_set_wins_over_clear", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Acknowledge or W1C a level-mode source while its input is high, and an edge-mode source at the cycle of its rising edge. Check that PENDING stays set after the clearing edge in both cases."},
    {"id": "T-MASK", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_irq_mask_random", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "Apply random ENABLE, MODE and src sequences with random W1C and ACK writes. Compare irq every cycle against a reference model of OR(PENDING & ENABLE)."},
    {"id": "T-PRIORITY", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_priority", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "Set multiple pending and enabled sources, including source 0 and source N-1. Check that irq_id is the lowest set index, that it moves to the next one after ACK, and that it is 0 when irq is low."},
    {"id": "T-CLAIM-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_claim_read_format", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Read CLAIM in idle and active states for each source. Check that bit 31 equals irq, bits 4:0 equal irq_id, and all other bits are zero."},
    {"id": "T-LATENCY", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_irq_latency", "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Sample irq and irq_id immediately after the edge that sets PENDING, after an ENABLE write, and after ACK. Check that they change in the same cycle as the register change, with no extra cycle of delay."},
    {"id": "T-RANDOM", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_random_scoreboard", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "Constrained-random stress of all inputs and register writes. A cycle-accurate reference model checks PENDING, irq and irq_id every cycle."},
    {"id": "T-ILLEGAL", "kind": "test", "file": "irq_ctrl_tb.sv", "name": "test_illegal_writes", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM", "IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Write ones to the unused register bits and CLAIM writes with out-of-range ids. Check that no state changes beyond what the spec allows."},
    {"id": "A-RESET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "Asserts that when rst_n is low at a clock edge, ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are zero after that edge."},
    {"id": "A-UNUSED-ZERO", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_unused_bits_zero", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Asserts that bits N and up of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are always zero."},
    {"id": "A-W1C-NOSET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_pending_set_only_by_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "Asserts that a PENDING bit goes 0 to 1 only when its source is detected under its mode, never because of a register write."},
    {"id": "A-ACK-ONEHOT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_ack_clears_only_named", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Asserts that a CLAIM write changes at most PENDING bit wdata[4:0], and changes nothing when that id is N or more."},
    {"id": "A-SET-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_detect_beats_clear", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Asserts that detection at an edge implies the PENDING bit is set after that edge, regardless of a concurrent W1C or ACK."},
    {"id": "A-MASK", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_equals_pending_and_enable", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Combinational check that irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE) at all times, with no clock delay."},
    {"id": "A-PRIORITY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_id_lowest", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Combinational check that irq_id equals the index of the lowest set bit of PENDING & ENABLE, or 0 when none is set."},
    {"id": "A-CLAIM-FMT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_claim_rdata_format", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM", "IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "Asserts that when addr==3, rdata == {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}, and that when addr is 0 to 2, rdata equals the selected register combinationally."},
    {"id": "A-READ-STABLE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_no_change_without_write_or_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-READ", "IRQ-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Asserts that ENABLE and MODE change only on a write to their own address and then equal wdata[N-1:0], and that reads alone never change state."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
